_comment: Editorial content for JVDCPS. This is a preference-share line of Javedan Corporation Limited, not a separate business. No image is attached.
description: Javedan Corporation (Preference) is a preference share class of Javedan Corporation Limited, the PSX-listed property developer whose ordinary shares trade as JVDC. Javedan Corporation is the developer of Naya Nazimabad, the large gated, master-planned residential project in Karachi that it describes as its central undertaking. This line is a separate class of capital from the company's ordinary shares and is not an operating business of its own.
sourceNote: PSX Data Portal security record for JVDCPS (name 'Javedan Corporation (Pref)') and the company's own website jcl.com.pk, plus nayanazimabad.com (who we are), read 2026-10-17.
